timing_notes: Frame distributions measure wall-clock intervals between process-frame callbacks.
last_gpu_ms and last_render_cpu_ms are end-of-phase samples, not aggregate distributions.
The live benchmark runs physics and the production camera controller; it is not deterministic replay.
Held benchmarks retain active rendering, effects and HUD. Their camera route follows wall-clock time.
Per-frame GDScript profiling wrappers are absent from both timing builds.
Original quality is display-limited, so its FPS does not measure uncapped throughput.

fixture_correction.reason: Initial whole-map fixture disabled Game but left the World PAUSABLE process group active. Its repeated references moved. The final fixture recursively freezes process groups and shader TIME; comparison tolerances are unchanged. This was a correctness-fixture run, not a timing run.

unsupported_material_modes.reason: The default fixture deliberately forces volumetric fog, which Gfx.on disables outside Forward+. Ground-contact variants with forced volumetric fog exceed the Adreno 28-varying limit in both baseline and candidate. The supported-only test is opt-in; the default fixture still probes all modes.

initial_gpu_profile_sample.note: Last profile block before the initial stationary phase result; diagnostic sample, not a whole-run distribution.

round2-production-modes.note: Same-process shader experiments, including rejected variants. Final APK measurements are under comparisons.

round2-fog-early.note: Same-process shader experiments, including rejected variants. Final APK measurements are under comparisons.

device_observations.notes: Read-only sampling. Clocks were not locked; device performance and fan settings were not changed.
